title: Stop, Focus, Plan, and Change: Predicting Parent and Child Responses to a Brief, Telehealth Parent Training
official: Stop, Focus, Plan, and Change: A Translational Approach to Predict Parent and Child Responses to a Brief, Telehealth Parent Training
summary: This study will look at who does not improve after doing a behavioral parent training program briefly through telehealth. It will also study ways to make the intervention better for those that do not improve.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Parent speaks English or Spanish
* Parent has access to Internet
* Parent intends to complete treatment
* Parent reports child has elevated externalizing concerns

Exclusion Criteria:

* Child is a ward of the state
* Child diagnosed with severe medical or nonverbal developmental disability
